_comment: Install bundles for `bin/skills-sync select`, and the groups decide-skills' index is sorted by. Order matters: a skill in several profiles is indexed under the first. `core` is always installed. A skill's own requirements live in its frontmatter (metadata.requires) and are pulled in automatically.

profiles.name: core
profiles.summary: Entry points: route to any skill, orient, set up. Always installed.

profiles.name: coding
profiles.summary: The daily engineering flow: idea, spec, tickets, implement test-first, review, debug.

profiles.name: deep-review
profiles.summary: Heavier lenses for big or risky changes: major-change review, blast radius, design comparison.

profiles.name: typescript
profiles.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript rules and fallow static analysis (needs the fallow CLI).

profiles.name: agent-ops
profiles.summary: Long-running or unattended agent work: fan-out, decision trails, resuming, verification skills.

profiles.name: productivity
profiles.summary: Learning, questionnaires, clarifying confusion, and plain-prose editing passes.

profiles.name: writing
profiles.summary: KB's essay and reading workflows. Personal to KB's voice; adapt before relying on them.

profiles.name: business
profiles.summary: Test ideas, value propositions, consequential decisions, structured problem solving, company blog posts.

profiles.name: video
profiles.summary: HyperFrames: explainer and product-launch videos rendered from HTML.
